name: Maishuu Kin'youbi no Kaerimichi
source:
From the first day of the second semester, I've had a fever and had to rest. I was recommended to join the "cleaning committee" who had to clean the whole school every Friday, which everyone hate when I go to school!

Let's make memories at the cleaning committee with my childhood friend Nishino Nao and my senior Enjoji Yori!

[Translated from [url=https://nanaaprilfool8.wixsite.com/my-site/%E6%AF%8E%E9%80%B1%E9%87%91%E6%9B%9C%E6%97%A5%E3%81%AE%E5%B8%B0%E3%82%8A%E9%81%93]official website[/url]]
translation:
第二学期开学第一天，你就因为发烧请了假。回到学校后才发现，自己竟然被推选进了人人避之不及的“清扫委员会”，每周五都得为全校进行大扫除！

与青梅竹马西野直，以及高你一级的学长圆城寺缘知一起，在清扫委员会创造回忆吧！
